sloka: सारथे तुरगाञ्छीघ्रं योजयस्व रथोत्तमे ।स्वास्तीर्णं राजभवनात्सीतायाश्चासनं कुरु ।। ७.४६.२ ॥
transliteration: sārathe turagāñchīghraṁ yojayasva rathottame ।svāstīrṇaṁ rājabhavanātsītāyāścāsanaṁ kuru ।। 7.46.2 ॥

translations.english: O charioteer, quickly harness the horses to the excellent chariot and prepare a well-cushioned seat for Sita from the royal palace.
